mentions.name: Tower Chess
mentions.description: A simple browser-based tower defense game designed for quick play during a lunch break, written in Kotlin and compiled to run in the browser using TeaVM.
mentions.audience: People looking for a quick browser game to enjoy during their lunch break
mentions.source_excerpt: A simple browser tower defense to enjoy during your lunch break. Written in Kotlin, TeaVM has made it possible to run surprisingly complex Java games, didn't expect it!
